item.blurb: Ando Raises $20M Seed. Ando raises $20M in a seed round from Accel, Index Ventures, and Emergence Capital to grow its AI agent-native team messaging platform.
Codebreaker Labs Raises $4.5M Seed. Codebreaker Labs raises $4.5M in seed funding led by Kickstart to scale its genomic AI platform and develop proprietary variant Atlases.
Scholar Education Raises $2M Seed. Scholar Education raises $2 million in a seed round to expand its AI-powered education technology platform and special education support services.
Kontext Raises $4M in Funding. Kontext raises $4M in funding led by 42CAP to expand its runtime security platform for controlling autonomous AI agents in workplace environments.
MCO Raises $100M Growth Capital. MCO raises over $100M in growth capital to accelerate product development and AI innovation for its financial services compliance platform.
Subconscious Raises $5.1M in Funding. Subconscious raises $5.1M in a funding round led by MassVentures to launch an AI inference platform designed to reduce costs for long-running AI agents.
